parameters.content:
## ESPN Scores, Standings, Teams & News by League

**Actor:** [ESPN Scores, Standings, Teams & News by League](https://apify.com/vexaloom-labs/espn-scores-standings-teams-and-news-by-league)

**Docs:** https://github.com/bolvein-firex/scraping-n8n-workflows/blob/main/docs/espn-scores-standings-teams-and-news-by-league.md

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy an API token.
2. In n8n, create a **Query Auth** credential:
   - Name: `Apify API Token`
   - Query parameter name: `token`
   - Value: your Apify token
3. Open **Run Apify Actor** and select that credential.
4. Click **Execute workflow**. The rows appear in **Rows ready**.
5. Optional: enable **Google Sheets** and set your document and sheet.

### Notes
- This calls the public Actor endpoint. No API token is stored in this file.
- `run-sync-get-dataset-items` waits up to 300 seconds. For large runs, switch to the async run + dataset endpoint.
- Public data only. Respect the target site's terms and local law.

### Input fields
- `mode` (string, required)
- `league` (string)
- `leagues` (array)
- `datePreset` (string)
- `startDate` (string)
- `endDate` (string)
- `season` (integer)
- `seasonType` (string)
- `teamIds` (array)
- `eventIds` (array)
- `athleteQueries` (array)
- `athleteIds` (array)

### Output fields
- `mode` (Mode)
- `sport` (Sport)
- `league` (League)
- `name` (Name)
- `status` (Status)
- `homeTeam` (Home Team)
- `awayTeam` (Away Team)
- `homeScore` (Home Score)
- `awayScore` (Away Score)
- `date` (Date)

description: ESPN scores, standings, teams: runs the ESPN Scores, Standings, Teams & News by League Apify Actor, returns mode, sport, league, homeScore, awayScore and more, then normalizes and dedupes the rows before an optional Google Sheets append.
